content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant, and the Tenant hereby rents from the Landlord, the property located at 123 Elm Street, Springfield, State of Novaria.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term_of_Lease
content_blocks.text: This lease shall commence on April 1, 2024, and continue until March 31, 2025, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rental_Payment
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay the monthly rent of 1,200 Novarian Dollars to the Landlord on the first day of each month, commencing on April 1, 2024.
